entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 07.09.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Chas P.S. Case No.271 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. No.1135 of 2022,
registered for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 324, 354, 307 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It appears that the applicant is accused of committing rape on the false pretext of marriage.
It has also been alleged that the applicant has attempted to take life of the victim by assaulting with knife.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
5. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.

Further, it has been submitted that both the parties were in relationship for the last three years which suggests that it was consensual and the allegation of 307 Shivcharan Bauri @ Shivcharan vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172865031/
1 IPC is false and frivolous.

entities.text: 307 Shivcharan Bauri @ Shivcharan vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
6. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
7. Considering the statement of the victim-lady and material available on record, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail, at this stage.
Accordingly, the present bail application stands rejected.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
